  WHY: Those stop labels land in the remove set, which the reviewer says violates the requirement to preserve them. Sonnet judged this a non-defect (documented existing design) and dropped it.

  WHY: The reviewer says the test contradicts the implementation and the PR description. Sonnet checked this claim and judged it not to hold.
